properties.comment: This report delivers the calculated residual performance value for each 5 minute trading interval

fields.doc: Date and time of the trading interval (DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS) fixed to the UTC+10 time zone (NEM time)
fields.name: INTERVAL_DATETIME

fields.doc: Region ID of the residual performance
fields.name: REGIONID

fields.doc: Version (FPP run number from the FPP database)
fields.name: VERSIONNO

fields.doc: Raise performance value in MWHz units (calculated by FPP for that trading interval taken from FPP database)
fields.name: RAISE_PERFORMANCE

fields.doc: The reason flag showing the decision matrix for the raise performance value Supported values are: 0 = Performance is calculated based on good input data 4 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable 8 = Performance is Null as FM is unreliable 12 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable and FM is unreliable
fields.name: RAISE_REASON_FLAG

fields.doc: Lower performance value in MWHz units (calculated by FPP for that trading interval taken from FPP database)
fields.name: LOWER_PERFORMANCE

fields.doc: The reason flag showing the decision matrix for the lower performance value Supported values are: 0 = Performance is calculated based on good input data 4 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable 8 = Performance is Null as FM is unreliable 12 = Performance is Null as Input data is bad or unavailable and FM is unreliable
fields.name: LOWER_REASON_FLAG
